summary: Additive-only PR: 12 Playwright E2E spec files, shared helpers/users/auth.setup, playwright.config.ts, .gitignore, a PROGRESS.md update, and a thorough PHASE2_BATCH_B_FINDINGS.md report. No application source, schema, migration, auth, or .github/workflows/** files are modified — confirming the deterministic tier1 classification. The worker correctly observed the hard rule on .github/workflows/**: the additive non-blocking e2e CI job was authored but deliberately NOT committed (push token lacks workflow scope), and this is documented honestly in the findings doc rather than silently attempted and lost. Tests are well-architected: they assert against the live API's own captured responses (avoiding pre-fetch races), use minimum-count/delta assertions (correct for an additive, no-teardown shared live org), locate fields via a DOM-sibling helper that documents a real systemic accessibility gap (no htmlFor/id association), and include dedicated regression tests for two real app bugs they discovered (procurement requisition 500, procurement tab-reset). The non-admin access check legitimately confirms a middleware route-protection inconsistency without exposing any data (APIs still 401). No correctness or security defects in the test code itself; no secrets beyond the intentional, already-in-repo-plaintext E2E test-org password. No workflow-file push is required by this diff.
